latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Generator From Video (v1.0.0)
- Upload existing video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and generate shareable clips automatically, with no manual editing required.
- Supports natural language instructions like “generate a 60-second highlight clip from this long video”, returning 1080p MP4 output.
- Handles session management, authentication, and error recovery automatically; anonymous users get 100 free credits valid for 7 days.
- Provides quick access to timeline state, credits, and export functions via simple commands or keywords.
- Fast cloud-based processing (typically 30–90 seconds per job); supports previews, iterative editing, and multiple file types.
